quest.description: A wind-carved gallery through the cliffside where harpies nest and something older keeps them fed. Two mouths open onto the hills — the wind uses both, and so can you.

0,0.description: The west mouth of the roost, whistling a long dry note. Feathers and small bones carpet the threshold.

1,0.description: A descending gallery strung with old snare-lines, set by someone who feared what roosts below.

2,0.description: A nesting alcove of woven branches and stolen cloth. The nest is warm.

2,1.description: The long perch — a natural ledge above a black drop, walkable if nothing shrieks at the wrong moment.

2,2.description: The heart of the roost, ringed by picked-clean offerings. The harpies do not land here. Something else holds this floor.

2,3.description: A wind-tunnel passage, smooth as a bottle's neck. The howling is loudest here.

2,4.description: The magpie-hoard: everything shiny the flock ever carried home, heaped in a wind-sheltered bowl of stone.

1,4.description: A climbing shaft with convenient handholds. Several are not stone.

0,4.description: The east mouth of the roost, opening onto open sky and a long fall for the careless.

characters.name: Roost Harpy
characters.description: A brood-guard drowsing over her nest, one yellow eye always open.

characters.name: Shriek Harpy
characters.description: The flock's alarm and its first talon. Her cry has started every fight this roost has ever seen.

characters.name: Roost Wraith
characters.description: The old cold thing the harpies feed. It drifts an inch above its ring of offerings, patient as weather.

items.name: Windwrap Cloak
items.description: A cloak of layered grey feathers that spills blows aside the way a wing spills wind.

items.name: War Accordion
items.description: A battered squeezebox in oxblood and brass, swung with conviction.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A small vial of red liquid that restores health.

objective.description: Stand in the heart of the roost.
